title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E12 — Mother’s Day
When Moesha borrows money from Frank to buy a mother’s day present for Dee, but only gives Dee socks, Frank is upset.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E13 — Baby Love
Frank and Dee announce they want to have a child of their own, surprising Moesha and causing Miles to run away.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E14 — Hakeem’s New Flame
Hakeem gets a girlfriend, making both Kim and (surprisingly) Moesha jealous.  They conspire to break up the romance, resulting in a heart broken Hakeem.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E1 — The List
Moesha and Kim discover some boys at school have a list of the girls with various physical attributes including the “biggest booty” and Moesha is astounded to find her name on the list.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E2 — Credit Card
Moesha has her own car, so Frank gives her a credit card for emergencies only.  When she goes out with her new boyfriend, Q,  he convinces her to let him drive her car.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E3 — Mama Said Knock You Out
Moesha has befriended a Latina student, Teresa.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E8 — House Guest
P.J. has a fight with her mother and moves out of the home they share and into Mark's home.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E9 — My Achy Breaky Back
In order to go on an important coaching interview after he hurts his back, Mark undergoes some experimental treatment for the pain at the doctor's office where Vanessa works. Series director Mark Linn-Baker ("Perfect Strangers") guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E10 — True Romance
Vanessa finds out her new boyfriend is not as rich as he wants her to believe. Tyler asks Mark for advice on girls.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E11 — Clothes Make the Man
Vanessa rescues Steve and Mark when they are tricked into buying new expensive clothes from a beautiful saleswoman who tells them they are very attractive and wants them to model in a calendar. Geneva is convinced Nicole is a future chess champion.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E12 — The Christmas Show
Mark's job as Santa at the mall and his Christmas plans at home both fail miserably, but the Christmas spirit triumphs.Christmas episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E13 — Coach
Mark becomes the new head coach of the undefeated basketball team after Coach Corley quits. He starts to think that he doesn't have what it takes to be a winning coach when the team loses their very first game under his coaching.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E14 — One is the Loneliest Number
After Mark and Denise's break-up, Mark discovers that he really does love her and jumps through hoops to get her back. Nicole and Tyler work together selling candy bars in an effort to win the prize for the most sold, a CD player.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E15 — True Lies
In order to be with his girlfriend, Mark lies to Nicole. Mark allows Nicole to punish him after she realizes that he lied. But soon he is tempted to lie to her again.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E16 — The Ringer
As the new coach of Nicole's floundering all-girl baseball team, Mark conspires to dress Tyler up as a girl to help the team. Baseball greats FRANK ROBINSON (himself) and ALBERT BELLE (himself) also came to help.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E17 — Down in the Dumps
Mark and Vanessa think that they won the lottery but can't find their winning ticket.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E9 — Simple Gifts
Katherine's rich Uncle Charles visits for Christmas. George is worried Webster is forgetting the important part of the season.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E10 — Nerds Are People Too
When Webster decides to join the school's community service club, he finds that all of its members are nerds. But after giving back to a community of retirees, Webster discovers that nerds are people too.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E11 — The Cruise
George and Katherine recall how they met on a two-week Greek cruise, fell in love, and got married before it was over.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E12 — Dial K for Katherine
Katherine is bugged by a message left on her answering machine: a prisoner against whom she testified has been released and wants to talk to her.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E13 — Homecoming
George learns that Nicky's school's football team is recruiting players from outside the district.

A school fundraiser has boys putting together “date baskets” on which the girls bid.
